scope: All explicit 7.0/7.1 requiresVersion sites and version-labelled API declarations in the pinned SDK dist, plus changes from manifest 6.9 to 7.0 to 7.1. Not a claim about undocumented vendor behavior.

gates.contract: Both registration version and manifest minimum are checked. Default cache clones settings, seeds on appearance, replaces on received settings and deletes on disappearance/setSettings. Getter IDs suppress callbacks; PI edits notify; runtime writes do not notify themselves.
gates.remaining: Accepted/rejected owner ordering and real Runtime SQLite settings/global clean-restart persistence passed in the local isolated candidate. Actual inspector browser and reference-host parity remain independent.

gates.contract: Version and manifest gate. ID-bearing didReceiveResources resolves getter without onDidReceiveResources callback; resources are a map of local file paths associated with the action.
gates.remaining: The local candidate proves genuine SDK getters against real Runtime managed files after source deletion and clean restart. Complete V3 import/export, reference-host behavior, crash recovery and other native platform flush guarantees remain separate.

gates.feature: Set action resources and PI resource notifications
gates.contract: Version and manifest gate. Files associated with an action are included in export. Runtime setter must not masquerade as a PI change; PI changes notify action listeners.
gates.remaining: The local candidate proves genuine SDK-to-Runtime staging, immediate saved read, rejected missing-file staging preserving prior state, and clean-restart persistence. Browser arbitrary-file selection is unavailable. Reference-host, crash and native platform qualification remain separate.

gates.feature: Resources on single-action and multi-action event payloads
gates.contract: Action event payloads include resources, including an empty map when no resource is associated. Existing action metadata must survive settings updates.
gates.remaining: Candidate covers empty appearance maps, distinct single/multi input maps and changed-settings resource/action metadata. Complete vendor export and reference-host payload parity remain separate.

gates.contract: Version and manifest gate. Device name/size changes update the SDK device store before listener delivery; no fabricated reconnect.
gates.remaining: Synthetic-device evidence does not qualify physical devices or reference-host race/order behavior.

gates.contract: Manifest adds SupportedInKeyLogicActions boolean, default true. This controls availability inside vendor key logic actions.
gates.remaining: Manager Gesture supports configurable tap/double/hold through existing nested multi-action pulse transport, requiring both key-logic and multi-action eligibility flags. Picker/save and normal/manual/tracked dispatch enforce those flags. Exact vendor timing, nested payload/state/context and release behavior remain unqualified. Explicit declarations require manifest minimum 7.0, admitted by the production 7.1 subset; older omitted=true defaults can also use the bounded Manager behavior. This SDK candidate does not itself qualify key logic.

Production contract and registry remained 6.9 during that historical run; promotion to the explicit 7.1 subset was separately reviewed afterward. Evidence prose is recorded after the tested snapshot.
